enchant_guidance.label: Best In Slot Gear for Feral Druid DPS in Phase 1
enchant_guidance.text:
Should Feral DPS Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
Unlike most other specs in TBC, the choice of Aldor versus Scryer faction has almost zero impact on the long-term PvE performance of a Feral Druid. For Feral DPS, the only permanently relevant items provided by these factions are the two shoulder enchants:  and , which require Exalted reputation with the Aldor and Scryer factions, respectively. However, these items provide an effectively identical increase, so simply choose whichever you'd prefer.
